name: colossus_hammer_flier_that_entered_after_the_hammer_loses_flying
notes: Bug hunt 2026-11-17 (hunt3 F1). 'Equipped creature gets +10/+10 and loses flying.' The Hammer enters first, then a real flier (Air Elemental, its flying a compiled keyword record) enters, and the Hammer is equipped to it. A printed ability is not an effect with a timestamp (CR 613.1, 613.7): the Hammer's loss removes it whatever entered first. The ground 2/2 is offered the block. Failed before the fix: the flier's own keyword record, registered after the Hammer's static, gave flying back.
